text: Every layer built so far only runs by hand. This video wires Bronze, Silver, and Gold into one Databricks Workflows job that runs itself, in order, every night.
Three tasks, two dependencies: ingest, then update the Silver pipeline, then refresh both Gold tables -- each one gated on the task before it actually succeeding.
The job is a JSON spec, version-controlled like any other code, not a set of clicks only one person remembers how to reproduce.
Scheduled for 2am, after every clinic submits and after their own billing export runs -- with max_concurrent_runs at 1, and a failure alert wired to all three tasks, not just the last one.
Proved it by breaking Bronze on purpose -- Silver and Gold both skipped instead of running on stale data. Next: a number Finance says still doesn't add up.
